changes_made.explanation: Normalized model names to include size specifications (base/large) for consistency and accuracy. Added BERT-large which is explicitly mentioned in the paper.
The extracted answer and metric are correct. The paper uses Exact Match (EM) to evaluate answer extraction performance.
The paper does not use LLMs as judges/evaluators. LLMs are used as components of the system (T5 as reader) but not for evaluation purposes.
The paper does not conduct human evaluations. All evaluations are based on automatic metrics (Exact Match for answer extraction, top-k accuracy for retrieval).

overall_notes: The paper focuses on Open-domain Question Answering with a two-stage pipeline (retriever + reader). The main contributions are improving retriever training through unsupervised pre-training and supervised fine-tuning, and exploring end-to-end training approaches. The paper evaluates primarily on retrieval accuracy (top-k metrics) and answer extraction (Exact Match). The extraction was generally accurate, with minor normalization needed for model names.
